name: @w6w-apps/learnworlds
description: Manage LearnWorlds courses, users, enrollments, tags and payments for your online school.

w6w.longDescription:
LearnWorlds is a per-school online course platform — each customer runs their own branded school on its own subdomain or custom domain — and this app puts the daily loop of running one behind a workflow: courses, users, enrollments, tags and payments.

Course catalog reads (list courses, get a course, get its sections and learning units) cover the read side. User management is the core of the write side: create and update users, and attach or detach tags to segment them for automations and reporting. Enrollment actions let a workflow list, add, or remove a user's access to a course, bundle or subscription — the same action LearnWorlds' own admin console performs when an instructor manually grants or revokes access. Payment history rounds it out, for reconciling a purchase against the enrollment or automation it should have triggered.

Authentication is OAuth2 client credentials, minted per school from Settings → Developers → API — available on the Learning Center and High Volume & Corporate plans. Health checks track LearnWorlds' own status page alongside a live reachability probe of this connection's specific school domain, since a suspended plan or a renamed subdomain is a different problem from a vendor-wide outage.

Deliberately out of scope for this first pass: course/bundle/subscription-plan creation beyond reading the catalog, promotions and coupons, affiliates, certificates, community spaces and posts, user groups and roles, seats, and webhooks — each is its own surface in LearnWorlds' API, left for a future pass.
